d:
In this track, I’ve flipped the legendary sample “Main Hoon Don” from the iconic movie Don. The song delves into the duality of Don’s persona, exploring two sides of his character while revealing who the real Don is for me. With its sharp lyrics and homage to a classic, this track is a lyrical journey of identity and power.
